remark: Seasons of Use line; 'End of' read as the last day. Chip closes 09-07 (Labor Day), 23 days before the stated close, so the nights after it are not reservable. Current Conditions: 'Campground is open for use, with no fees' and the gate closes 'once we have snow on the ground' (off-season use, not a closure; 'Site Partially Closed' header is the normal off-season). rec.gov names no first-come sites, only 'contact the Lowman Ranger District ... for off-season camping information'.

remark: Seasons of Use line; chip closes 09-07 (Labor Day). rec.gov notice: 'Some first come, first served sites may be available' (booking has no fcfs value). The note's mid-2026 hazard-tree closure is not on the page now: Current Conditions reads 'Campground is open for use, with no fees' (off-season use).

FS page has no Seasons of Use line (Operational Hours gives only check-in/out); header 'Site Open' with 'Water system is off for the season.' Payette NF /conditions page lists no campground dates. rec.gov 234030 gives no season, only 'Opening day is dependent upon snow levels' and 'Sites may be available on a first come, first served basis outside the reservation season', so the chip's 09-15 close is likely the reservation end, but no open season is stated. FS page: '12 first-come, first-serve sites ... and eight sites which may be reserved' (matches booking fcfs some_sites).

quote: Open seasonally beginning april 17 and ending 10/3026
remark: The page gives the season two ways: Current Conditions 'Open seasonally beginning april 17 and ending 10/3026' (presumably 10/30/26: 04-17 to 10-30) vs Seasons of Use / Operational Hours 'May 12 - September 18'. Both edges conflict, so agency_season is left empty. The chip's 09-17 close matches the Seasons of Use line but not the current-conditions 10/30 close, which would make the chip a booking-window edge; rec.gov 231831 states no season and no first-come sites. Needs a human call.

Current Conditions line; Seasons of Use agrees on the close: 'May 16, 2024 - Reservation Season ends September 16, 2024. Campground closes October 31, 2024'. Chip's 09-15 close is the end of the reservation season (booking.season ~05-16 to 09-16). Page: '34 campsites are available; 23 offer electricity and 19 campsites are reservable'; rec.gov: 'Additional sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis.' The entry's booking has no fcfs value.

BLM page states no season (fees, accessibility, recreation.gov link only). rec.gov 273785 states only the reservation window: 'Huckleberry reservations arrivals can now be secured between May 21 through October 25, 2026', which matches the chip's 10-25 close but is a booking season, not an open season; it adds the water system shutdown 'will begin sometime during the week of October 20th'. BLM page mentions 'walk-in reservations' via on-site Wi-Fi/self-service fee station.

quote:

remark: Seasons of Use line; close matches the chip's 09-30 and the agency adds the April open the chip lacks. Page: 'Sites may be booked at Recreation.Gov through the end of September.' No closure is listed on the page now (the note's mid-2026 location closure is not shown); Current Conditions: 'Water has been turned off for the season, starting 10.2.2026'.

quote: The campground is open year-round, however the group site becomes first-come first-served in the Winter.
remark: rec.gov facility text (Recreation section); the BLM page states no season but says 'Individual sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis' (matches booking fcfs always). Facility 10362432 is the group site only, so the chip's 02-10 to 11-30 span is the group site's reservation window. rec.gov notice for the group site: 'NO TRAILERS, Max Vehicle length 25'.'
